'''Selena''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[Gender|female]] member of the [[Nightsisters]] during the [[Clone Wars]] and the [[Parent|mother]] of the [[human]] [[Morgan Elsbeth]]. She [[Death|died]] during the [[Battle of Dathomir]], killed by [[General]] [[Grievous]] during a duel.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Stand your ground.|Selena commands the Nightsisters following a swift retreat|<ref name="The Path of Fear" />}}
[[File:SelenaEnchantedBlades-TPoF.png|thumb|left|300px|Selena wielding her enchanted sickles]]
Selena was a [[Gender|female]] member of the [[Nightsisters]] on the [[planet]] [[Dathomir]], where she lived with her [[human]] [[Parent|daughter]] [[Morgan Elsbeth]].<ref name="The Path of Fear" />

During the [[Battle of Dathomir]] in the [[Clone Wars]], Selena participated in the Nightsisters' defense of their home against the invading [[battle droid]]s of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Also among the fighters was Selena's daughter, Morgan. As several Nightsisters retreated from the [[Separatist Droid Army]]'s overwhelming forces. One blast from a [[B2-series super battle droid]] nearly killed Elsbeth, but Selena saved her daughter's life, pushing her out of harm's way. The Nightsisters prepared to make their last stand, but were quickly ambushed by the Separatist [[droid]] [[General]], [[Grievous]], who impaled one of them from behind with one of his green [[lightsaber]]s. As [[BX-series droid commando]]s rained fire on the Nightsisters, Selena ordered her daughter to stay back. She attacked Grievous using two sickles enchanted with [[magick]]. However, despite her powers, she was unable to defeat Grievous, with the [[cyborg]] gaining the upper hand, damaging her sickles with his lightsabers. They engaged in a blade-lock, only for Selena to be stabbed in the torso when Grievous activated a third blade from his left arm. In her final moments, Selena ordered her daughter to run. Grievous laughed, then struck Selena down with his three lightsabers as Elsbeth watched in horror before fleeing the scene.<ref name="The Path of Fear" />

==Powers and abilities==
As a [[Force-sensitive]] Nightsister, Selena was able to use magick and could enchant her sickles to make them resistant to contact with lightsabers. She was a skilled warrior and was able to fight Grievous for a while before being defeated. She also cared for her daughter, saving her life in a blast and urging her to flee in her final moments. <ref name="The Path of Fear" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I thought it was great because it gave me a chance to do a different voice, like a whiskey, tenor voice, but I also thought, she is Morgan’s role model for being a woman warrior.|Diana Lee Inosanto talking about Selena|<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|228|Diana Lee Inosanto (article)}}</ref>}}
Selena first appeared in "[[The Path of Fear]]", the first episode of the animated miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Empire]]'', released in [[2024]]. Selena was voiced by [[Diana Lee Inosanto]], <ref name="The Path of Fear" /> who also voiced Selena's daughter Morgan Elsbeth in the following two episodes and portrayed her in live-action. To differentiate the character from Morgan Elsbeth, Inosanto tried to give her a "[[whiskey]], tenor voice".<ref name="Insider" />
